Inline an icon as HTML

Source: R/get.R
iconify_html.Rd

Returns the icon's SVG as htmltools::HTML(), ready to print in R Markdown or Quarto chunks (results = "asis"), inline code, or Shiny UI.

Usage

iconify_html(id, ...)

Arguments

id

Icon id of the form "prefix:name", e.g. "mdi:home".

...

Passed to iconify_get() (color, size, flip, rotate).

Value

An object of class html (see htmltools::HTML()).

See also

iconify_get()

Examples

iconify_html("mdi:home", color = "steelblue")
#> <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path fill="steelblue" d="M10 20v-6h4v6h5v-8h3L12 3L2 12h3v8z"/></svg>
